correctness.rationale: Three exhaustive collision cases yield the stated exact masses: all distinct D=1-3s2+2s3 gives each rank equally likely, each double pattern has probability E=s2-s3 and nonidentity involutive comparisons are fair, and all equal has probability s3. Pairwise probability transfers strictly increase both relevant CDFs until uniform. Two score orders for the fully exchangeable four-coordinate null give distinct M=3 laws by exact integer summation. A standalone program passed 5163 rational assertions across 165 weight vectors and all 24 four-state score orders, plus the witness and smoothing.
